concepts.name: Greeting
concepts.description: A personalized hello message built from an optional visitor-supplied name. The name is trimmed of surrounding whitespace; an empty or whitespace-only name falls back to World. The message reads Hello, <name>! and is returned with a fixed subtitle. Computed per request; nothing is stored.

bindings.description: Read-only endpoint that computes the greeting for the optional name query parameter.
Response shape carrying the message and subtitle.
Applies the trim and World fallback rule and formats the message.
